Subject: Vendr portal delta manifest and hygiene request

Hi Kimberly,

We ran a consistency pass on Clarion Therapeutics' Vendr profile and flagged a small set of fields and proofs that are out-of-date (S3 bucket links rotated, expired cert screenshots, and a few CAIQ mappings). To keep the public profile in sync with Clarion's SOC 2 evidence, we'd like to request a short delta upload rather than a full reingest.

Attached is a delta manifest (clarion_vendr_delta_manifest.csv) that lists the affected QIDs and preferred evidence types. Can you: 1) confirm who will stage new artifacts, 2) provide pre-signed PUT links (48h TTL), and 3) tell us whether Clarion needs help re-mapping any SIG->CAIQ rows?

Timeline: if we get links by 2028-10-06 EOD PT we can schedule the delta ingestion for 2028-10-07 morning and keep the public profile live.

Quick note: our ingestion tool requires either: a) S3 presigned object for each file, or b) vendor-upload via the Vendr UI (we can open a delegated upload window on request).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15 to walk through the manifest.

—
Liam O'Neill
Vendr Portal Ops

portal@vendr.com

- Presigned links: we can provide S3 PUT links for each file; request 48h TTL is fine.
- SIG->CAIQ mapping: Ben will triage the rows flagged in the manifest and call out any questions; I expect at most a couple clarifications.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm that you can pick this up and send a first pass of links by EOD tomorrow (2028-10-06)? If it's tighter, tell Liam whether Vendr UI delegated upload is preferred (we may need vendor access).

I can join a 15-min walkthrough if helpful — propose 2028-10-06 10:00 PT. Liam, would that work?

Hi Kimberly / Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the quick reply. Per Liam's note I've attached the manifest and an example upload mapping doc (clarion_evidence_index_v2.xlsx). A couple of small clarifications from our side:
- Please include a checksum (sha256) for each artifact in the S3 object metadata if possible.
- For any screenshots or cert PDFs, filename pattern should be: QID_fieldname_version.pdf (example: SIG-225_cert-2028-09.pdf)
- If you prefer delegated upload we can open a 48-hour window for Clarion and share a secure token; if you open that path please confirm the secondary contact for the upload (we need a full name + email).

I've created ticket VC-48219 to track the ingestion. Once files are uploaded we'll run a light schema validation and push the delta to the live profile. If any rows fail validation we'll attach a failure CSV to the ticket.

Hi Liam / Vendr team —

We're on it. Ben and I reviewed the manifest and did a quick pass against Clarion's current evidence bucket. Plan:

1) Ben will produce the updated cert PDFs (3 files) and a new SOC2-control-evidence.zip that contains the latest artifact exports.
2) I'll generate S3 presigned PUT URLs for each file with 48h TTL and include sha256 metadata. Links will point to s3://redwood-evidence/clarion/2028-10-05/ as requested.
3) If any mapping questions remain, Ben will mark them in the manifest and flag to Liam via the ticket.

Deliverables & timing: presigned links + sha256 manifest by 2028-10-06 17:00 PT. If Vendr needs delegated upload instead, reply-all and we'll pivot (but presigned links are our preference to avoid portal access setup).

Ben — assigning you as primary on the artifact creation. Kim — I'll update the intake doc and mark this as a delta hygiene job in our tracking sheet (HS-83472).
